author: badgg
body:
Hello! Today I bring to you the sequel to the map Crescent: Subtle.

Album (latest)
YAML (latest) 
Download [latest]

A map purely based on gameplay, with jump pads and the common two layer map. Moving around the map is made easy, with Speed II permanently however keeping an eye on your enemy will be difficult if you play as a solo. TNT is in the map. This map makes it almost impossible to switch sides swiftly, so sneaking around wouldn't help. I've encouraged all players to use the top layer, since there is an area with cover, and an area without. The bottom is mainly used for monument defense.

Team spawns are below the map, to prevent spawnkilling / killfarming to an extent. 

Iron supply is close to front lines, meaning games shouldn't last too long if a team has control over the enemies iron supply.

Please leave suggestions / feedback / ideas, that would be greatly appreciated!
